conviction_note: The quarter is pre-released. A MAR Art. 17 ad-hoc on 2026-10-21 gave 9M revenue >EUR800m, EBITDA ~EUR180m and orders EUR1.1bn, and raised the FY26 EBITDA margin guide to ~22%. The release therefore carries only detail (backlog, cash flow, segments, Q4 colour). The one live upside line is a narrowing of the unchanged 5-9% revenue guide, because its low end implies a flat Q4 after a +17% Q3. That gives a small positive lean (p_up 55) on a name that moves a lot on report days (abs 5.0). The findings sum to +1.0 against a scaled +0.5; the gap is the probability-of-change discount on the guidance line, which is measured differently in the two numbers.

already_public.what: Ad-hoc (Art. 17 MAR) of 2026-10-21 14:20 CEST: preliminary 9M 2026 revenue >EUR800m (PY 753.2m), EBITDA almost EUR180m (PY 131.8m), 9M EBITDA margin ~22% (PY 17.5%), order intake EUR1.1bn (PY 777.3m). FY26 EBITDA margin guide raised to ~22% (from 20-21%); revenue growth unchanged at 5-9%. The stock closed +12.1% that day (35.94 -> 40.30).

H1 2026: revenue EUR503.2m, EBITDA EUR98.9m (19.7%), orders EUR723.4m, backlog EUR824.8m, FCF before interest and tax EUR47.2m, net debt EUR307.5m. The revenue guide was specified to the upper half of the prior range. Management warned the H1 order momentum 'may not continue in the second half' because it was partly driven by major orders.
Implied Q3 2026, derived from the two documents above: revenue >~EUR297m (+~17% on Q3 2025's ~EUR254.8m = 753.2-498.4), EBITDA ~EUR81m (~27% margin, against ~EUR53.0m in Q3 2025), orders ~EUR377m.
Post-ad-hoc broker target raises: LBBW 52 (Buy), MPCM 51 (Buy), Jefferies 49 (Buy), UBS 45.50 (Neutral), Oddo BHF 42 (Neutral).

new_in_release.expect: Q3 detail confirming the pre-release, so roughly on the bar. The open question is how much of the ~27% Q3 EBITDA margin was product mix or one-offs; the ad-hoc says 'unter anderem durch den veränderten Produktmix'. Direction unknown.

Most likely the revenue guide (5-9%) and the ~22% margin are reiterated, three weeks after the raise and three weeks before the 3 Dec CMD. Some chance the revenue range is narrowed to the upper end: 9M is +6.3%, Q3 +~17%, and the backlog is likely ~EUR900m. Slightly positive if it changes.
Unknown. H1 FCF was EUR47.2m despite a working-capital build; the order ramp could absorb more working capital in Q3.
Order backlog at 30 Sep: not stated in the ad-hoc. Arithmetic puts it near EUR900m (824.8 + ~377 orders - ~297 revenue), up from EUR658.9m a year earlier. Mildly supportive and largely inferable.
Q4 colour from the new CEO Dorfner, who started in August. Strategy and mid-term targets are reserved for the 3 Dec 2026 CMD in Dresden.

findings.finding: The 9M numbers are already out in the 2026-10-21 ad-hoc. What the release adds is detail the market has not seen exactly: a 30 Sep backlog near EUR900m (computed), segment margins and cash flow, all mildly supportive and largely inferable.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: FY2025 was pre-released on 2026-02-13 (+2.4%), and the full report on 2026-03-25 still moved +14.6%, but on a dividend increase and the first 2026 guide rather than the pre-released lines. Q3 2024 was preceded by a negative ad-hoc in Oct 2024 and still fell -4.5% on the statement day (2024-11-12).
findings.original_quote: Auf Basis vorläufiger Zahlen lag der Auftragseingang des Konzerns in den ersten neun Monaten bei 1,1 Mrd Euro (i. Vj. 777,3 Mio Euro). Der Konzernumsatz erreichte mehr als 800 Mio Euro (i. Vj. 753,2 Mio Euro) und das EBITDA lag bei knapp 180 Mio Euro (i. Vj. 131,8 Mio Euro). [Based on preliminary figures, group order intake in the first nine months was EUR1.1bn (PY 777.3m). Group revenue exceeded EUR800m (PY 753.2m) and EBITDA was almost EUR180m (PY 131.8m).]
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: the stock jumped 12.1% on the ad-hoc, and since 20 Oct it is +1.5% while ASML is about -8% and SUSS about -17%, so it held the gain relative to its sector. Only the exact backlog and cash-flow figures are unseen. Sized near zero for that reason.
findings.independence: The H1 report gives the 824.8m starting backlog: https://www.jenoptik.us/news/press-releases/2026/08/12/results-of-the-first-half-year-2026

findings.finding: The unchanged 5-9% revenue guide looks conservative. On FY2025 revenue of EUR1,046.0m, its low end implies Q4 revenue of about EUR293m, flat on Q4 2025 (~EUR292.8m), after a Q3 that grew ~17% on a backlog near EUR900m. The ~22% margin guide implies a Q4 margin near 21% against ~27% in Q3. A narrowing to the upper end on 10 Nov is plausible but not the base case.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Guidance moves have been large here: the 2026-10-21 margin raise +12.1%; the H1 'upper half' specification on 2026-08-12 +5.2%; the first 2026 guide on 2026-03-25 +14.6%; the Oct 2024 target postponement -7.6%.
findings.original_quote: Auch für das gesamte Geschäftsjahr 2026 erwartet der Vorstand daher nun eine EBITDA-Marge von rund 22 Prozent (vorher 20 bis 21 Prozent). Das Umsatzwachstum im laufenden Jahr sieht der Vorstand unverändert zwischen 5 und 9 Prozent gegenüber dem Vorjahr. [The Executive Board therefore now expects an EBITDA margin of around 22% for the full year 2026 (previously 20-21%). It sees revenue growth this year unchanged at between 5 and 9%.]
findings.why_not_priced: The implied-Q4 arithmetic is public, and stock3 noted the guide 'unterstellt keine weitere Verbesserung im Schlussquartal' (assumes no further improvement in Q4). What is not priced is the chance of an actual narrowing on the day. Since 21 Oct the stock has been driven by sector beta, which suggests nobody is positioned for a guide tweak. Kept small because the guide was set three weeks ago and the new CEO has a CMD on 3 Dec at which to reset expectations. Two-sided: an explanation that the Q3 margin was one-off mix would be read negatively.
findings.independence: stock3 makes the same reading of the guide (Q4 margin not assumed to improve): https://stock3.com/news/jenoptik-halbleiterboom-sorgt-fuer-hoehere-margenprognose-aktie-sprinht-zweistellig-17344137. ASML (Q3 on 2026-10-14) said 2027-28 supply will fall short of demand: https://investinglive.com/stocks/asml-says-2027-and-2028-supply-will-fall-short-of-demand-as-q3-sales-hit-a-record/

findings.finding: The fall into the print (5d -7.4%, 20d -6.7%) is sector beta, not company news. Semicap peers fell harder on the same days (2026-11-04/05: SUSS -4.7%/-10.0%, Aixtron -6.3%/-9.8%, ASML -3.4%/-6.5%; JEN -5.2%/-6.7%), so the run-up carries no company-specific information, and the day's move will carry heavy sector beta.
findings.why_not_priced: This is the price itself; the finding is that the run-up control is sector-driven. Neutral on sign.

baseline_tension: The lean (+0.34) and the 5d/20d run-up (-7.4%/-6.7%) are sector-driven. The findings lean slightly positive against a negative tape, but only through a guidance-narrowing possibility, so the scaled number stays small.
language_note: The German Finanzkalender (jenoptik.de/investoren/finanzkalender) carried the 3 Dec 2026 Capital Markets Day in Dresden, which moves strategic news out of the window; the English IR calendar URL was a 404.
The German ad-hoc text ('unter anderem durch den veränderten Produktmix', 'unverändert zwischen 5 und 9 Prozent') was identical in substance to the English version; nothing extra.

German retail and finance press (stock3, goldesel) carried the post-ad-hoc broker target list and the 'no further Q4 improvement assumed' reading. No English equivalent was found, but it is wire-derived and priced.
lessons_applied: 'A finding about a number the market has already been told is worth 0': the pre-released 9M finding went from +0.5 to +0.2, leaving only the unseen backlog and cash-flow detail.

'Too small about the move' / 'the tail is intact': abs_move_pct went from 4.5 to 5.0, given 68% 20d realised volatility and report-day moves of +5% to +15% on the last four prints. It stays near the pre-released base because the guide is unlikely to move three weeks after a raise.
Reaction history moves p_up, not size: the last four report days were all up, so p_up went from 54 to 55, kept within 45-55 because the period is pre-released.
